subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers require inspectable Google Chat app-auth proof before accepting this fallback, or explicitly waive the live proof gap after the code blockers are fixed?
rationale: The external contributor has supplied tests and narrative production confirmation, but not an inspectable artifact from the real Google Chat app-auth path; only maintainers can waive that proof gate for this channel.

options.title: Require Proof After Repair
options.body: Ask for redacted Google Chat app-auth logs, terminal/live output, screenshot, recording, or linked artifact after the predicate and metadata blockers are fixed.

options.title: Waive Live Proof Explicitly
options.body: Accept source/API-contract proof plus regression tests, but record the live Google Chat proof gap in the merge decision.

options.title: Use A Different Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers choose another open Google Chat fallback PR as the canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Require Proof After Repair
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Google Chat app-auth logs, terminal/live output, screenshot, recording, or linked artifact after the predicate and metadata blockers are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat API/action/media-path history makes steipete the best available routing owner for the proof and canonical-branch choice.
